boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Duquesne study settings, from reservable library rooms and technology-equipped collaboration areas to school-specific and residential lounges.

cards.entity_name: Gumberg Library Glass Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Bring the Project Team to the Fifth Floor
cards.subtitle: Reservable group rooms with whiteboards and power
cards.notes: Reserve ahead, bring at least three people, then scan the entrance QR code within 15 minutes so the booking is not canceled.
cards.short_summary: A bookable fifth-floor workspace designed for collaborative sessions that need a board and nearby power.
cards.evidence_claim: Gumberg Library states that its Glass Group Study Rooms are on the fifth floor, are intended for groups of three or more, and include whiteboards and power access.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Gumberg Library Study Rooms
cards.access_notes: For groups of three or more. Advance booking is available; confirm the reservation by scanning the room QR code within 15 minutes of the start time.

cards.title: Spread Out in FlexTech
cards.subtitle: Seven technology-oriented collaborative workspaces
cards.notes: Use this setting when a team needs distinct collaboration stations; check library scheduling before counting on classroom availability.
cards.short_summary: A flexible library classroom organized around seven separate collaborative work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne's current undergraduate catalog says Gumberg Library contains a FlexTech classroom with seven collaborative workspaces.
cards.access_notes: Located within Gumberg Library. Classroom scheduling or other use constraints should be checked with the library before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Gumberg Library Graduate Student Study Room
cards.title: Settle Into the Graduate Study Room
cards.subtitle: A library study area dedicated to graduate students
cards.notes: Bring your Duquesne identification and use this room for graduate-level work; verify current entry details with library staff on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated option for graduate students who want to work inside the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne's accepted-graduate-student information identifies a dedicated graduate student study room among Gumberg Library's resources.
cards.access_notes: Dedicated to graduate students. Confirm the room's current location and identification requirements with Gumberg Library.

cards.title: Build a Lesson in the Curriculum Center
cards.subtitle: PreK–12 books, games, puppets and teaching materials
cards.notes: Come with a lesson or child-focused project in mind, then work directly with the center's books, games and curriculum materials.
cards.short_summary: A resource-rich library room for studying education and developing work intended for children.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne describes the Maureen P. Sullivan Curriculum Center as a PreK–12 resource room open to anyone in the campus community working with children, with books, games, puppets and teaching resources.
cards.access_notes: Available to members of the campus community working with children; library access rules apply.

cards.title: Take a Table in the Fish Bowl
cards.subtitle: The Duquesne Union's largest study lounge
cards.notes: Use the Union's largest study lounge for an between-class work block, and consult current building hours before an evening session.
cards.short_summary: A named, centrally located Union lounge that provides a larger-format alternative to library rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne's current facilities catalog identifies the Fish Bowl, across from Starbucks, as the Duquesne Union's largest study lounge.
cards.access_notes: Inside the Duquesne Union across from Starbucks. The Union currently lists daily building hours, but hours may change by term or holiday.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes at the Commuter Center
cards.subtitle: First-floor Union lounge, kitchenette and study facilities
cards.notes: If you commute, settle into the lounge between classes and use the kitchenette or computer facilities without leaving the Union.
cards.short_summary: A commuter-focused home base combining comfortable seating with practical amenities for a campus workday.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne says the first-floor Commuter Center has comfortable lounge furniture, a kitchenette and computer facilities and is intended as a home base for commuter students.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Duquesne Union and designed for Duquesne commuter students.

cards.title: Plug In at Collaboration Commons
cards.subtitle: Union Room 112 with computers, printer and meeting displays
cards.notes: Choose Room 112 for group work that benefits from a display; bring your files ready to print or open on the provided computers.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped commuter workspace suited to collaborative assignments between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne identifies the Commuter Collaboration Commons as Room 112 and says it provides computers, a printer and meeting displays for collaboration or study between classes.
cards.access_notes: Room 112 in the Duquesne Union's commuter facilities; intended for commuter-student collaboration and between-class study.

cards.entity_name: Thomas R. Kline School of Law Research and Study Rooms
cards.title: Brief the Case in Kline's Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Research and study rooms inside the law-school building
cards.notes: Use these rooms for case reading or small-group preparation, and confirm law-student access and room procedures before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated research rooms within the law building place focused work near classrooms and legal instruction spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne's current facilities catalog states that the Thomas R. Kline School of Law building contains research and study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Inside the Thomas R. Kline School of Law. The cited page does not state eligibility or reservation rules; verify them with the school.

cards.title: Keep the Work Session Close to Home
cards.subtitle: Residential study lounges in Assumption Hall
cards.notes: Residents can use the hall's study lounges for work away from their rooms; ask the front desk about guest access and current rules.
cards.short_summary: An on-site study alternative for students living in Duquesne's oldest residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne's official Assumption Hall page lists study and social lounges among the residence hall's amenities.
cards.access_notes: Residential amenity inside Assumption Hall, which primarily houses first-year students. Confirm guest access at the security desk.

cards.entity_name: McGinley Hall Study and Collaboration Spaces
cards.title: Move the Group Project Downstairs
cards.subtitle: Study and collaboration areas in McGinley Hall
cards.notes: McGinley residents can shift group work out of their apartments; coordinate with the building desk before inviting nonresident partners.
cards.short_summary: Purpose-built collaboration areas within Duquesne's newer apartment-style student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Duquesne's current facilities catalog says McGinley Hall includes student lounges and study/collaboration spaces and houses juniors, seniors and graduate students under eligible leases.
cards.access_notes: A residential amenity in McGinley Hall. Housing is offered to eligible Duquesne juniors, seniors and graduate students; verify guest policy.
